crops.feature: cab end: cab side window, first door, roof grille, bogie
crops.reading: Cab car front: gangway frame proud of a vertical face, cab side window (two upper panes, chamfered lower pane, one black outline), then a two-leaf door with a centre seam and one narrow rounded window per leaf, roof box over the door, first saloon window with a hopper line.

crops.feature: inner end of the cab car: last window, door, small window, gangway
crops.reading: Inner end: last saloon window, two-leaf door, one small narrow window, then the car end and bellows; roof box over the door.

crops.feature: front (inner end) of the next car
crops.reading: Next car's front (inner end): small narrow window, two-leaf door (navy in NT), then the window row; the next car is the mirror of the cab car.
Cab side window: one black rounded outline, two upper panes split by a vertical bar, lower pane with its rear-bottom corner chamfered. Matches the diagram shape.
crops.reading2: two upper panes split by a vertical bar, smaller lower pane with lower right corner cut at an angle; black outline, rounded corners.

crops.reading: First door: TWO leaves, silver, centre seam, one tall narrow rounded window per leaf, yellow step edge. Not a single leaf.
crops.reading2: two door leaves in light grey/white with a dark vertical seam, one tall narrow window with rounded ends in each leaf; yellow step edge below.

crops.feature: second door and small window at the inner end
crops.reading: Second door: two silver leaves with centre seam, wheelchair sign, then one small narrow window before the car end.
crops.reading2: pair of grey/white leaves with central seam, two narrow rounded windows, wheelchair symbol; narrow vertical window to the right.

crops.reading: Nine saloon windows of near-equal size in rubber gaskets; the 1st and 6th have a top hopper pane.

crops.feature: EMR lines (split swoosh) along the cab car
crops.reading: EMR purple with two thin pale lines that run as one from the doors and split into a lens round the 'EMR REGIONAL' lettering; orange cantrail line.
crops.reading2: two thin pale grey lines spread apart into a lens/eye shape around the lettering and come together toward each end; thin orange line at the top edge.

crops.feature: roof line: grilles over both doors, cantrail vents
crops.reading: Roof light grey; a louvred grille box over each door; small louvred vents in the bodyside just under the cantrail; orange cantrail line.
EMR face: yellow upper face round both screens; purple band across the face from the lower slots down (also on the gangway door's lower part); grey skirt.
crops.reading2: yellow front with a purple lower band and grey valance; yellow gangway door with purple bottom panel; left pod clear lamp outer, red LED centre; right pod red centre, clear outer.

crops.reading: Black lamp box: round clear headlamp and red LED tail of similar size side by side; headlamp outboard (left box of the face).
crops.reading2: clear round reflector lamp on the left, red LED cluster on the right; outer side not decidable from the crop alone, f-face-emr puts clear outer.

crops.reading: GWR: all yellow face including the angular skirt; yellow gangway door with GWR logo and bike sign, no door window; number on the yellow under the right lamp box.
crops.reading2: all yellow including the lower valance with angular facets; door with bicycle symbol and GWR lettering; left pod clear outer, red centre; right pod red centre, clear outer.

crops.feature: cab corner, cab window and first door, three-quarter
crops.reading: Cab corner to first door: yellow wraps only a few cm round the corner, then green; cab window; two grey door leaves with a pale green stripe.
crops.reading2: cab window (two panes, angled lower pane), then a pair of greyish door leaves with a central seam and a tall narrow rounded window each, light green stripe across them.

crops.reading: Black box: clear round headlamp outboard, red LED tail inboard.
crops.reading2: clear round lamp middle-left, red LED at the right; clear lamp outer, red centre.

crops.reading: Door: two grey leaves, centre seam, one window each, pale green stripe; next window split by a hopper bar; grey line along the body at the stripe height.
crops.reading2: pair of grey leaves with a seam and one narrow rounded window each; light green stripe; window split into smaller upper and larger lower pane; thin light grey line along the body.

crops.feature: roof from above: grilles, exhausts, eyebrow vents
crops.reading: From above: black hooded box cluster on the roof centre behind the cab, louvred vents at both cantrails, front dome all yellow with an orange line.
Northern: yellow face incl. a yellow bar across the top of each screen (destination pane above); grey skirt on this unit; number white on black at the screen foot.
crops.reading2: yellow front with grey/silver lower valance; left pod lit headlamp outer, red tail centre; right pod red centre, clear round middle and a small amber lamp outermost (three elements).

crops.feature: Northern blue cab end, its curved rear edge, first door
crops.reading: Northern blue cab end with a curved rear edge into white, three 'n' roundels on the blue, first door white/light grey two-leaf.
crops.reading2: dark royal blue bodyside, white area at left with an edge curving into the blue; three 'n' arch symbols; pair of light grey door leaves with seam; cab window two panes plus angled lower pane.

crops.reading: Northern box (near side): red tail inboard, round headlamp, and a small rectangular extra lamp outermost.
crops.reading2: red round lamp at left, large clear round lamp in middle, small rectangular clear lamp at right; f-face-nt makes the small rectangle outer.

crops.reading: ScotRail: yellow face and yellow skirt over a rusty brown plough; LED cluster inboard, round headlamp outboard; number black on yellow under the right box.
crops.reading2: bright yellow front, yellow lower valance over rusty brown skirt; right pod LED cluster centre, clear round lamp outer; '158711' in black on yellow below the right lamps.

crops.feature: dotted saltire round the cab window
crops.reading: White dots in a saltire arrow round the cab window, larger near the front and smaller towards the rear, on blue.
crops.reading2: white dots of varying size sweeping across the cab door area, shrinking toward the bottom right; cab window among the dots.

crops.feature: light blue diamond band low on the bodyside
crops.reading: Light blue dots in staggered rows low on the bodyside, large at the door end and fading towards mid-car.
crops.reading2: light blue ovals in staggered rows, large at left, shrinking and fading toward the right and bottom.

crops.reading: TfW: grimy yellow face and skirt; round headlamp outboard, white LED marker/tail cluster inboard; number on yellow under the right box.
crops.reading2: dull yellow front, all yellow including valance; left pod lit warm-white round lamp outer, white LED cluster centre; '158 835' black below right pod.

crops.reading: TfW door: two red leaves (open), black edges, one narrow window each, grey body round them.
crops.reading2: two tall door leaves, red with black outline and one narrow rounded window each; door open.

crops.reading: Lit round headlamp outboard, white LED (5x5 dots) cluster inboard.
crops.reading2: large lit warm-white round lamp left, lit white LED cluster right; matches f-face-aw left pod: round outer, LED centre.

crops.reading: SWR 158: yellow upper face, navy/black lower face and skirt, gangway door yellow with navy foot; number white on black at the screen foot.
crops.reading2: yellow front with navy/dark lower body and valance, orange line under the roof; left pod lit round lamp outer, LED cluster centre; right pod LED centre, round outer.

crops.feature: SWR 158 cab end and silver section
crops.reading: SWR 158: dark navy cab end meeting a light silver middle at a long straight diagonal leaning back towards the roof; navy runs on low under the silver.
crops.reading2: dark navy at the right/middle and light grey at the left; boundary a long diagonal from high near the roof down and to the left; door pair with light blue at the top.

crops.reading: Head-on 159012: yellow face to a straight line below the lamp boxes, navy below; black screen recesses each one outline from the destination pane to the lamp box; gangway frame black, door yellow with navy foot, no door window.
crops.reading2: yellow upper face and dark navy lower half; gangway surround grey/black with yellow door with navy lower panel; each side a dark window panel with a lamp pod: plain round lamp outer, red LED centre on both sides.

crops.reading: Left box head-on: round clear headlamp outboard, red LED tail inboard, same height; box rounded at the outer-bottom corner.
crops.reading2: grey/clear round lamp on the left (outer), red LED cluster on the right (centre); black pod with rounded lower corners in a yellow surround.

crops.reading: Right box: red tail inboard, clear headlamp outboard; number panel above.
crops.reading2: red LED cluster on the left (centre side), clear round lamp on the right (outer).

crops.feature: right windscreen recess: destination, glass, number panel
crops.reading: Right recess: destination display top, wiper housing bar, main glass, black number panel with white '159 012', then the lamp box; all in one black outline with rounded top corners.
crops.reading2: orange dot-matrix display in a dark panel with a rounded top; windscreen with wiper; black band with '159 012' in white; yellow surround.

crops.feature: lower face: slot, ledge, skirt, coupler pocket
crops.reading: Lower face: navy band with a black slot each side, a ledge at the body bottom, skirt below sloping inwards, black coupler pocket in the middle.
crops.reading2: lower front corner dark navy, bumper-like valance and separate lower skirt, recessed dark slot; yellow meets navy at a straight horizontal line.

crops.feature: top of the face: dome, gangway frame top, left screen top
crops.reading: Top of the face: yellow dome to the roof edge, orange line across the face, black gangway frame top just below the dome, screen recess top corners rounded.

samples.what: EMR face yellow under the lamp box
GWR grey line under the windows
